_doc: HOW OFTEN THE HAND'S SHAPE CHANGES — three alternatives to look at (SW-88; RUNNING_LOG §293), drawn by tools/chord_changes.js on the workshop's pages 'chords: few / some / many'. page = the IR the notes are read from · window = the passage read (both hands) · view = what the page shows · headOpacity = the played notes, kept faint as his reference · spans = each alternative's ONE knob: how many semitones a hand may reach before its shape is written again.

sets._note: §294 (his criterion): a hand's PLACE is the range of the notes it has been using; a note within tolSemis of it belongs to it; an event outside it starts a NEW set only if at least `share` of the notes of the next lookS seconds are outside it too — otherwise it was a passing reach. A set lasting under minDurS is brief: a particular harmony for the standard notation, not a shape. A set is FOUNDED on its first foundS seconds (within foundSpan semitones) and then HELD — it does not grow.
